name: Carla the Witch
original_name: カーラ・ザ・ウィッチ
source:
An obstinate and competitive "witch".
Carla, unlike her peers, has a strong sense of chastity and is a clean freak.
She is captured during a witch hunt.

Her signature weapon is a jousting spear.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://clockup.net/maggotbaits/character2.html]official website[/url]]
